work.title: Additive basis thresholds for random prime semigroups
work.abstract: Admit $2$ and select each odd prime $q$ independently with probability $\min(1,\lambda q^{-\gamma})$. We study sums from the multiplicative semigroup generated by the selected primes. At $\lambda=1$, its least asymptotic basis order is almost surely $\lfloor(1-\gamma)^{-1}\rfloor+1$ for $0<\gamma<1$. On the critical line $\gamma=1-1/k$, the multiplier threshold for cofiniteness of the $k$-fold sumset is $1+1/k$. At equality the probability of cofiniteness is strictly between zero and one. Almost every realization at equality admits a finite addition of primes that makes its $k$-fold sumset cofinite and a finite removal of optional primes that gives infinitely many gaps. The proof combines a lower sieve and a prime-support overlap estimate for representations with a stopped martingale that compensates surviving gaps.
work.subject: math.NT
work.comments: Establishes the almost-sure additive basis order, the critical multiplier threshold, and strictly intermediate cofiniteness probability at equality. Includes finite-modification results at the critical threshold.
